 About Igor Pajač

 Available seasons2022/2023 – 2026/2027
 Competitions10
 Igor Pajač, born on September 30, 1985 in Zagreb, Croatia, is a 39-year-old Croatian football referee. He made his debut in the top division of Croatian football, the SuperSport HNL, on March 5, 2016. Throughout his career, Pajač has been selected to officiate at prestigious European competitions. In the 2024/2025 season, he officiated matches in the group stage of the UEFA Europa League, including the match between Ferencváros and Tottenham on October 3, 2024, which ended with a 2-1 victory for the English team. Pajač's refereeing style is characterized by consistent application of the rules and effective communication with players, allowing him to maintain control during matches. His experience in high-level matches reflects his ability to handle pressure situations in international football.
